public_comment.speaker: John Bowen Jr
public_comment.topic: Flag retirement ceremony and veterans recognition
public_comment.quote: john bowen jr , of 162 highland street, invited the community to participate in flag staking at veterans' graves on saturday, may 16th, beginning at north cemetery at 12:00 pm. he noted a planned interview with lunenburg public access on may 13th and announced a flag retirement ceremony on flag day, june 14th, at his property. he subsequently requested select board permission to conduct the flag burning ceremony

public_comment.speaker: Dave Rodgers
public_comment.topic: Budget season, override question, civic participation, senior citizens and student concerns
public_comment.quote: dave ro d gers , of 82 highland st reet , stated he is p leased the way debates regarding the budget have gone so far . mr. rodgers addressed the board at length regarding the upcoming annual town election and the override question. mr. ro d gers spoke to the importance of civic participation, stating that the t own has always come through in difficult periods. he cited statistics he found notable, including that the number of senior citizens in lunenburg is roughly equal to the number of students in the school system, and that the town food bank serves approximately one thousand people per month.

public_comment.speaker: Ana Lockwood
public_comment.topic: Alleged improper use of town seal, budget allocation decisions, affordability
public_comment.quote: ana lockwood , of 91 main street, raised concerns regarding the alleged improper use of the town seal in pro- override campaign materials. she also presented a fiscal analysis suggesting that budget allocation decisions including capital project funding, a f inance c ommittee reserve contribution above policy levels, and costs associated with hiring an assistant town manager had prohibited the schools from receiving level-service funding.

public_comment.speaker: John Bowen Sr
public_comment.topic: Affordability concerns, ethics complaint, student government election appeal
public_comment.quote: john bowen sr , of 162 highland street, echoed concerns about affordability and referenced a complaint he filed with ethics regarding the school superintendent 's use of the school 's messaging system that mr. bow e n found inappropriate . mr. bowen also spoke about a matter with the school committee in regard s to a student government election appeal involving his son

public_comment.speaker: Chair Caesar Nuzzolo
public_comment.quote: chair nuzzolo gave his reflections on this budget season stating line items a re real costs that affect real people and are not abstract numbers. he stated that he would be voting yes for tier 2, citing the importance of fully funding schools, first responders, and community programs
